criteria.text: With max_body_size unset (None) on Starlette, Router, Mount and Route, a large body is read in full and returns 200 as today.
Starlette, Router, Mount and Route with max_body_size=N each return 413 for a body over N and succeed for a body at or under N.
An inner route, mount or router limit higher than the app-wide limit allows a body the outer limit would reject; an inner lower limit rejects a body the outer would allow.
RequestBodyLimitMiddleware(app, max_body_size=N) wraps a plain ASGI app, returns 413 for oversized bodies and passes smaller ones.
A chunked body with no Content-Length, or an understated one, exceeding the limit yields 413; multipart bodies are counted in total including encoding overhead.
A declared Content-Length over the limit gets 413 and the app's receive is never called.
The 413 response is text/plain with body 'Content Too Large'; if the app already sent http.response.start, no second response is sent and the body stream stops.
When multipart parsing is interrupted by any exception (including the body-limit one), all spooled temp files are closed.
docs/applications.md, docs/routing.md and docs/middleware.md document max_body_size and RequestBodyLimitMiddleware.

intents.rationale: No max_body_size option exists on Starlette, Router, Mount or Route.

Starlette installs the limit middleware outside user middleware and routing; Router/Mount/Route wrap their inner app. An inner wrapper unwraps the outer counting receive so it can raise or lower the limit.
The middleware wraps receive and counts len(body) of every http.request message.
The middleware checks Content-Length up front and responds 413 without calling receive.
Middleware sends a PlainTextResponse 413 if no response has started, otherwise nothing more; the body stream is stopped.
MultiPartParser.parse only closes files on MultiPartException/OSError; it must close on any interruption.
Docs for the option and the middleware are needed.

summary: One PR: new RequestBodyLimitMiddleware plus max_body_size wiring on Starlette/Router/Mount/Route, multipart temp-file cleanup fix, docs and tests. The app-level middleware sits just inside ServerErrorMiddleware so the 413 isn't turned into a 500.

tasks.summary: Add RequestBodyLimitMiddleware first, then wire max_body_size into Starlette (just inside ServerErrorMiddleware, outside user middleware), Router, Mount and Route; make MultiPartParser close temp files on any BaseException; then add tests and docs.
